parameters.query:
SELECT
  (SELECT count(*) FROM detections
    WHERE timestamp >= $1::date AND timestamp < ($2::date + interval '1 day')) AS detections,
  (SELECT count(DISTINCT vessel_id) FROM port_calls
    WHERE arrival_ts >= $1::date AND arrival_ts < ($2::date + interval '1 day')) AS unique_vessels,
  (SELECT round(avg(wave_h_m)::numeric, 2) FROM weather_obs
    WHERE ts >= $1::date AND ts < ($2::date + interval '1 day')) AS avg_wave_h_m
